adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Linked hands, fingers, or hands on shoulders; sometimes arms are raised or lowered depending on the specific dance.
movement_profile.footwork: Varies; common patterns include three steps forward and one step back.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circle, semicircle, or curved line; moves around a central point or space.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Minimal movement above the waist in some traditions like Kolo; more energetic in others.
movement_profile.partnering: No individual partners; the entire group acts as a single unit.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, often facing the center of the circle.

signature_moves.description: Three steps forward and one step back in a counterclockwise rotation.
signature_moves.name: Hora step

signature_moves.description: Leader breaks from the semicircle to perform improvised, skilled steps.
signature_moves.name: Lawweeh lead

music_profile.musical_form: Cyclical, matching the circular movement of the dancers.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Repetitive, often driven by drums or vocal chorus.
music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by rhythmic, repetitive patterns that support the circular flow of the dance, often featuring a blend of vocal chanting and percussion.
music_profile.vocal_style: Group singing, often with a leader singing verses and the group responding in chorus.

basic_steps: Form a circle or line by holding hands, fingers, or shoulders.
Step forward in a rhythmic sequence (e.g., three steps forward, one step back).
Rotate the circle, typically in a counterclockwise direction.
Follow the leader's tempo and movement changes.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly as it requires no partners, but requires attention to group synchronization.
teaching.rhythm: Varies by tradition; often steady and repetitive to facilitate group synchronization.
